messages:
Anya: Heads-up — after yesterday's egress tighten in us-west-2 we're seeing an observability gap and a warm-pool impact.
Sam: Details?
Anya: SIEM stopped ingesting audit logs from privatelink endpoints. Also ~18 warm-pool GPU nodes failed to finish onboarding: KMS handshake timeouts during node decrypt.
Maria: :eyes: Do we have recent logs from the export path?
Anya: Example from the exporter:
```
ERROR exporter/shipper.go:289 failed_send: failed to POST /ingest: dial tcp 10.240.5.12:443: i/o timeout
WARN keystore/handshake.go:142 decrypt: context deadline exceeded
```
Luca: We're also seeing higher conntrack counts on the NATGW causing intermittent backoffs.
infra-bot: alert: keystore-handshake-timeout spike in us-west-2 (90m) — 72 alerts
Sam: Initial hypothesis: firewall rule tightened at 02:30 removed ephemeral egress to SIEM and increased NATGW queuing. KMS retries then hit deadline -> node fails join.
Maria: Can we do a quick scoped revert for the SIEM subnet egress and roll back the conntrack rule change? Prefer minimal blast radius.
Anya: Proposal:
- Temporarily allowlist SIEM exporter IPs in fw rule FWR-112 (10.240.4.0/24)
- Increase keystore handshake timeout from 10s -> 30s in warm-pool bootstrap (canary)
- Scale warm-pool target +20% to pull more healthy nodes
- Add an alert for audit-ingest-lag > 5m
Sam: I'll open the revert PR for the fw rule and tag @ops-oncall. PR: https://git.company/redwood/fw/changes/234
Luca: I'll validate NATGW conntrack metrics and increase target conntrack if needed. Also we should add a short-lived sampling on exporter to reduce pressure.
Maria: For KMS, do we have a safe canary? We can patch bootstrap config in staging then push to one warm-pool shard.
Anya: Yes — staging canary exists: warmpool-staging/shard-a. Maria please run canary. Steps in runbook.
Maria: On it. Running canary now. Will report in 10m.
ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor onboard queue and cost delta. If revert not possible within 15m, we'll fail open on the rule for SIEM.
infra-bot: patch-request: fw-revert PR created by Sam (#234) — CI checks passing
Maria: Canary succeeded — handshake timeout reduced error rate by 80% on shard-a. Warm nodes started successfully.
Sam: Revert merged and rolling deploy to prod fw (staging green). Will notify infra infra-deploy-bot.
infra-bot: deploy started: fw-service/us-west-2/rollout/234
Anya: Thanks. Follow-ups:
- Policy: add egress observability check to fw rollout playbook
- Ops: consider increasing default keystore handshake timeout to 20s across warm-pool
Luca: I'll open tickets for the policy and conntrack autoscaling tuning.
ops-oncall: Monitoring: audit-ingest-lag cleared; warm-pool join rate back to normal. Cost impact: ~+3% for 30m. Noted.
Anya: Great job everyone :tada:
